workItems.acceptanceCriteria: AC-01, AC-10 through AC-15 plus host AC-06/AC-09: prepare actual Type Manager before the one root Build and register the same instance; use one awaited StartedAsync lifecycle bridge with an explicit supported ordered host composition; retain truthful existing readiness and critical/noncritical health; health routes bypass the business 503 gate while real listener answers 500 during held startup and 200 after success; existing actual pipe probe observes 1/0. Keep HB inactive until all participants complete, positively acknowledge activation without waiting for callbacks/health, and preserve standalone HB behavior. Startup/HB close and true drains precede dependent stopping/disposal, including held initialization/final-publication stop races and failed-host-start cleanup. Deliver country-cache prime then dependent reader then recurring refresh/normal requests example using actual modules. Include existing-project integration/business/affected compatibility tests, guide updates and independent review. No alternate host framework, scheduler, health system, generic shutdown abstraction, new test harness or tooling campaign.

workItems.title: Implement once-only sequential startup with real DI construction and lifetime barriers
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: AC-02 through AC-09: add the single CIS.Startup.IStartable identity; enroll only ordinary unkeyed singleton interface registrations; validate final descriptors and use standard actual-root scope validation, materialize the full sequence once before any startup, reference-deduplicate preserving first occurrence, directly await actual tasks sequentially and retain one operation/first host token and success/fault/cancel without replay. Establish the existing critical condition monitor before participant construction when installed; preserve useful sync/null-task/async/unexpected-cancel failure and neutral known host cancellation. Cancellation never certifies actual settlement; final publication belongs to the same operation's stopping boundary and supports the narrow HB completion connection. Include focused real-DI controlled unit tests, usage documentation and independent review. Do not add a DI framework, second provider, scan, priority, retry, custom graph validator or generic hook registry.
workItems.validation: Build affected Core/Unit projects and run focused meaningful Startup enrollment, empty sequence, late-constructor-zero-call, registration/dependency-order, held-task, ref/equal-by-value identity, alias/lifetime/scope-validation, concurrent/repeated terminal-entry, sync/null/async fault, host/unexpected cancellation and actual-settlement tests. Inspect operation retention before user code and no user code under control locks. Preserve existing module behavior and ordinary PerformanceObservation/ExtendedStress exclusions. Record exact native symbols/results and AC mapping, actual cost/storage and responsibility-growth review in this task. Root controller serializes shared builds. Host acceptance remains owned by the dependent integration task.

workItems.title: Move concrete Heartbeat lifecycle wiring from startup coordination into hosting
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: Follow the user's explicit same-module refactor: StartupCoordinator has no concrete Heartbeat reference, field, constructor dependency, resolution or lifecycle calls. Hosting owns optional Heartbeat activation, cancellation registration, cutoff and actual drain. Preserve one retained sequential startup operation and terminal outcome, complete construction before invocation, activation acknowledgement before readiness, failure health reporting, cancellation during activation, no premature/reopened dispatch/readiness and actual startup/HB settlement before dependency disposal. Use the smallest internal completion connection if needed to keep the final transition in the existing retained operation; no new public lifecycle/DI framework. Preserve optional-module absence, current APIs, source bytes, prior results/owners and the user-owned untracked example launch settings. Include focused meaningful regression/dependency-boundary tests, usage documentation and independent review in this task.

Move activation-specific tests to exercise the actual hosting boundary rather than synthetic duplicated wiring. Preserve ordinary PerformanceObservation/ExtendedStress exclusions. Inspect original-task history, unchanged runtime dependencies/public surface and source hash; record actual counts, failures, costs and safe settlement within the same shared allocation. Serialize shared builds; no toolchain upgrade, new test harness, release campaign, publication or default-branch merge.
